$comment: Performance and page-weight budgets (ledger ENG-060, ENG-061). Limits are the v0.8 measurements plus about 10 percent headroom, rounded; Core Web Vitals limits are the 'good' thresholds. Text is measured gzip-compressed (as a host would serve it), images, fonts and video as stored. `measured` is the recorded v0.8 measurement; a value more than regressionTolerancePercent above it fails even when it is under its limit, so small regressions are caught early. `baselineGrowthPercent` caps the delivered total against the v0.8 baseline commit itself. To change a limit or the recorded values, change this file in a reviewed commit: `node engineering/checks/budgets.mjs --update-measured`. Video is not part of page weight: it is desktop-only, deferred and budgeted by file. FIRELIGHT (owner decisions of 2026-10-17, APR-JE-052 and APR-JE-053): the delivered total is limits.deliveredBytes; Home's own page limits and the three per-file image limits are the owner-approved values of budgets-firelight.json, written here as `exceptions` (pages and images, each with its approval id and reason) so the shared check:budgets can hold Home to them while Menu, Our story, Visit us and Order online keep the v0.9 limits above, unchanged. An exception that is malformed, names something that is not delivered, or cites an approval that is not in the approvals log applies nothing and fails the check. `measured` is the Firelight measurement.

index.html.reason: Home's own budget for The Breath (WebGL2 steam simulation in one script, the live dish at full resolution, two stylesheets, the footage): the values of APR-JE-052 Option A, each the measured value plus about 10 percent, recorded with their measurements in engineering/budgets-firelight.json. Only the limits listed here change; the other four pages keep the shared limits.
